subject: maths
counting: corpusCount = occurrences of the word at the start of a sentence or after a bracket across all 164 Standard question papers 2018-2026 under docs/sources/papers/maths (text scan 2026-09-05; counts only, no text kept). indexQuestions = questions whose parsed stem carries the word in data/papers/questions-index.json. typicalTariff is per part, in marks, provisional until the topic-level miner runs (master plan §3.4).
legal: Command words are reproduced as single words/short phrases (short factual items). Meanings, traps and coaching are ours.

words.meaning: Work it out with visible steps and put the number on the answer line.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Method (M/MA) for the correct process, accuracy (A) for the final value in the demanded form and unit.
words.trap: A bare answer scores full marks only if right; a wrong bare answer scores nothing.

words.meaning: Same as Calculate: show working, give the answer.
words.whatEarnsMarks: As Calculate.
words.trap: Same as Calculate.

words.meaning: Determine the value or expression; working expected when more than one mark.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Method then accuracy.
words.trap: Multi-mark 'Find' parts need the method visible.

words.meaning: No working needed; the answer is read straight from the information given.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One accuracy-type mark per item.
words.trap: Do not over-work it; but two answers offered for one line is marked at the poorer.

words.meaning: Start from the given information and reach the printed result with every step shown.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Method marks for the forward chain; the final line must match the given result.
words.trap: Working backwards from the result, or substituting it in, earns nothing.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05; research 01 §9.1 Q15(a); concept C §6.1

words.meaning: Give a complete, general argument (algebraic or geometric) with reasons for each step.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Marks for the chain of reasoning; a numerical check is not a proof.
words.trap: Examples do not prove; A-grade item (7% full marks on the sphere/cube proof).

words.meaning: Give the reason in words, tied to the numbers or the diagram.
words.whatEarnsMarks: A mark for the correct mathematical reason using the key words.
words.trap: Naming a rule ('Z angles') without applying it scores zero.

words.meaning: One mathematical reason, in full, applied to the data.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Key words plus the link to the figures.
words.trap: A label is not a reason.

words.meaning: State what is seen (a trend, a relationship) or, for transformations, every detail needed to define it.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One mark per required element.
words.trap: 'Describe fully' the transformation: name plus vector / centre, angle, direction / line / centre and scale factor.

words.meaning: Round the numbers first (usually to 1 significant figure) and calculate with the rounded values.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Marks for the rounding and the approximate calculation.
words.trap: An exact calculation scores nothing.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05; CER Summer 2025 M5 P1 Q3; concept C §6.1

words.meaning: Produce the graph, diagram or construction accurately (ruler, compasses, HB pencil); sketches show shape and key points.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Points/lines within tolerance; arcs for constructions; labels where asked.
words.trap: Freehand lines and rubbed-out arcs lose marks; papers are scanned.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05 (Draw 136, Plot 24, Sketch 5, Construct 3); research 01 §9.4

words.meaning: Find all values that satisfy the equation or inequality, with algebraic working; keep inequality signs.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Method marks for the rearrangement, accuracy for each solution.
words.trap: Trial and improvement earns no method marks; a dropped negative root loses accuracy.

words.meaning: Collect and cancel to the simplest form demanded (fully simplified fractions, surds, expressions).
words.whatEarnsMarks: Accuracy for the final form; a method mark on longer items.
words.trap: Stopping one step early ('in its simplest form' not reached).

words.meaning: Write as a product of factors; 'fully' means take out every common factor.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Accuracy for the correct factors; partial credit for one correct factor on quadratics.
words.trap: Do not set the expression equal to zero and solve when only factorising is asked.

words.meaning: Remove the brackets and collect like terms.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Method for the products, accuracy for the collected result.
words.trap: Sign errors on the middle terms.

words.meaning: Use the result of the previous part; 'or otherwise' releases the requirement.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Method marks only for the route that uses the earlier result.
words.trap: Another valid method scores zero unless 'or otherwise' is present.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05; concept C §6.1; FM evidence in packs/further-maths/exam-true/method-locks.json

words.meaning: Give the answer briefly, no working required.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One mark per stated item.
words.trap: Listing two candidates for one answer is marked at the poorer.

words.meaning: Method-locked: the named tool or result must be used.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Marks only for the named method.
words.trap: Pythagoras instead of the demanded scale drawing gained nothing.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05 (use a scale drawing 2); research 01 §9.2 (M7); concept C §6.1

words.meaning: Fill the table, diagram or sentence using the information given.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Usually one mark per correct entry or a mark for all entries.
words.trap: One wrong table entry can spoil later plots — but positive marking follows it through.

words.meaning: Select from the options printed; one selection unless told otherwise.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One mark for the correct selection.
words.trap: Two circled answers score zero.

words.meaning: Act on the diagram exactly as instructed (name the parts, shade the region, draw the image).
words.whatEarnsMarks: One mark per correct element; image vertices within tolerance.
words.trap: Rotation direction and centre; enlargement from the wrong centre.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05 (Label 39, Shade 20, Reflect 18, Rotate 15, Enlarge 14, Translate 12)

aliases: Give your answer in the form
words.meaning: Rewrite in the stated form (standard form, a ratio, a mixed number, the form y = mx + c, to a given accuracy).
words.whatEarnsMarks: The mark is for the demanded form; a correct value in another form usually loses it.
words.trap: 'in its simplest form', 'as a fraction', 'in pence' are enforced.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05 (Express 22, Round 19, Change 16, Convert 4; 'give your answer in/as/to' phrases 60+)

words.meaning: Rearrange the formula so the named variable stands alone on one side.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Method for each legal rearrangement step; accuracy for the final form.
words.trap: Subject appears twice: factorise first.

words.meaning: Use the ruler or protractor on the printed diagram and give the value with units.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Accuracy within the scheme's tolerance (inclusive range).
words.trap: Units (cm vs mm) and the printed range are inclusive.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05; CCEA General Marking Advice (x); CER November 2025 M1 Q6

words.meaning: Write every member of the required set.
words.whatEarnsMarks: All members for full marks; often a mark for a partial list.
words.trap: Extra wrong members can cost the mark.

words.meaning: Say how two things differ, using both sets of figures.
words.whatEarnsMarks: A comparative statement tied to values (e.g. median and spread for box plots).
words.trap: Comment on one side only.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05; CER November 2025 M7 Q26 (box plots)

words.meaning: Write the equation from the context before solving it; the equation itself carries marks.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Method mark for a correct equation; further marks for solving.
words.trap: Solving by trial without the equation earns nothing for the equation.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05; research 01 §9.2 (M2: 1% formed the equation); concept C §6.1

words.meaning: A question form rather than a command; treat as Calculate/Find when more than one mark is available, and as Write down when one.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Depends on the tariff shown in brackets.
words.trap: One-mark 'Which' items are marked at the poorer answer if two are given.

emphasisWords.note: Bold words inside stems that the marker enforces; stored on items as `emphasis`. Bold cannot be detected in the text corpus, so these come from the research reports and phrase counts.

items.source: corpus scan (250); CER Summer 2025 M5 P1 Q3

items.text: to 1 decimal place / to 3 significant figures / to the nearest ...
as a fraction / in its simplest form / in standard form / in hours and minutes
without using a calculator / you must show your working
items.source: corpus scan (2 / 20; 'show all your working' 53, 'show your working' 171)
